what: Reproduction of the published pi0.5-LIBERO benchmark numbers with openpi's own unmodified eval loop (examples/libero/main.py), run before any number off the sketch-prompted validation scenes was believed. Section 3 of prompt_pi05_baseline.md. Re-run at the published trial count on 13 August 2026; see RUNBOOK_REPRO_500.md and outputs/rollouts/openpi_repro_500/.
render_backend: egl (RunPod pod has no X server; openpi's glx advice is inverted here)
docker_note: A RunPod GPU pod is itself a container; nested Docker is unsupported, so openpi's 'Without Docker' path was used.
three_suite_note: Spatial, Object and Goal — the three suites the 114 validation scenes derive from. This is the figure the validation-scene results are compared against.
notable: Within libero_10, the task 'put both moka pots on the stove' scores 56.0% over its 50 trials while the other nine tasks average 97.6%. That single task accounts for essentially the whole of libero_10's shortfall against the other suites. It is the only standard-suite task built around two identical instances of the same object, which is the ambiguity class this project targets.
verdict: Reproduces at the published trial count. Every suite lands within 1.0 point of its published figure (largest difference: libero_10, 93.4 vs 92.4, above published; largest shortfall: libero_spatial, 98.0 vs 98.8) and the average is 97.0 vs 96.85 over 2,000 episodes with zero exceptions. At 500 episodes per suite the binomial standard error is about 1 point, so the residual differences are within sampling noise. The observation pipeline and the reference preprocessing are therefore certified before section 6.
